official_structure_semantics.Price Indicator: field before Price; blank means normal price

root_cause: The earlier v5 holiday extractor used fixed positional indices compatible with the later 10-field layout: row[7] as Price and row[8] as Msg Code. In the legacy 12-field layout row[7] is Price Indicator, row[8] is Price, and row[9] is Msg Code; legacy trades are coded Y rather than T. This mechanically caused early legacy CN archives to report zero parsed trades.

frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.column_resolution: resolve fields by normalized header names, not fixed absolute indices
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.legacy_trade_code: Y when the official legacy schema/header identifies the 12-field Price-Ind/Amend layout
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.later_trade_code: T when the later schema/header identifies the traded code T
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.settlement_code: S is not a trade and must never be used as an endpoint
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.amendment_policy: only normal/eligible trade records under the detected schema may form endpoints; deleted/corrected semantics must be handled explicitly rather than silently treated as trades
frozen_correction_rule_for_v6.price_normalization: preserve the previously frozen CN rule: parse numeric price; if raw numeric price >100000 divide by 100 exactly once; final sanity range 1000..50000

v5_preservation.note: The frozen v5 candidate remains historical evidence exactly as sealed. Phase 6 uses the corrected official schema for its new ordinary-session A50 dataset; it does not retroactively change the v5 receipt.
